channel.description: Recent content in Mcp on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.112
item.description:
Release v1.0.112 focuses on terminal/UI reliability, clearer error handling, and MCP/plugin/session fixes across narrow terminals, sidebar dialogs, and prompt flows. It also updates model selection defaults, session limit handling, and startup behavior, with additional improvements to copy/paste formatting and Unicode rendering.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.111
item.description:
Release v1.0.111 adds new permission-rule regex support, a one-time remote host session creation flag, and several MCP/plugin/workflow/session fixes. It also includes many terminal UI, rendering, and reliability fixes across /usage, /diff, /resume, search, paste handling, and startup/sign-in flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.110
item.description:
Release v1.0.110 focuses on CLI stability, layout fixes, and more robust handling of invalid config and terminal edge cases. It also adds experimental masked handling for password prompts and improves MCP, session, search, and model/account flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.109
item.description:
Release 1.0.109 focuses on CLI/IDE session reliability, settings/help text corrections, and permission/model handling fixes. It also adds IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow/deny rules and support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.108
item.description:
Release v1.0.108 adds numerous CLI behavior fixes, help-text updates, and MCP/autopilot improvements. Notable changes include better session/resume handling, more consistent permission and tool-call behavior, improved search and transcript rendering, and default installation/activation for managed plugins marked defaultEnabled.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.107
item.description:
Release v1.0.107 adds many CLI, terminal, sandbox, MCP, model-picker, and session-management fixes. Notable changes include inline image support in Rex terminals, a new /code command, a unified /settings dashboard with global search, and numerous corrections for Windows, Unicode, control-character handling, resumable sessions, and authentication flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.106
item.description:
Release v1.0.106 adds inline image support in Rex terminals, a new /code command, unified /settings/dashboard navigation, and several session/agent management improvements. It also includes many fixes for Windows, MCP/LSP/sandbox behavior, prompt editing, terminal rendering, and help/docs accuracy.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MCP gateway for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) routing in preview via a new MCPRoute custom resource. This lets platform teams expose MCP servers behind a stable hostname and path while centralizing TLS and JWT validation through Web Application Firewall features.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure MCP Server 3.0
item.description:
Azure MCP Server 3.0 is now generally available. The release expands Azure integration for AI agents and developer tools via the open Model Context Protocol (MCP), including new infrastructure-as-code support through Azure Terraform.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Custom skills, agents, and MCP servers in usage metrics API
item.description:
GitHub Copilot usage metrics API now reports organization-created custom skills, agents, MCP servers, slash commands, and plugins by name instead of grouping them together.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.103
item.description:
Release v1.0.103 fixes session, sandbox, and model-default handling, and improves response copying, reconnect behavior, and MCP/worktree reuse. It also updates remote launch flags and several tool-call edge cases.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.101
item.description:
Release v1.0.101 adds several CLI and MCP workflow fixes, including native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models, new assisted approval instructions, and more reliable sign-in and permission handling. It also fixes model selection, session resume/startup behavior, Windows/macOS shell command issues, and multiple provider-specific request and image-limit problems.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.100
item.description:
Release v1.0.100 adds new CLI flags and session/share commands, expands plugin and sandbox handling, and improves account, permission, and model management flows. It also fixes a wide range of reliability issues across MCP, Gemini, Windows, proxy, telemetry, and session browsing.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.98
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.98 adds Gemini 4 Argon support, improves command hook reliability, and fixes several session and UI/input issues.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.97
item.description:
Release v1.0.97 adds agent-scoped declarative hooks, improves plugin/MCP handling, and fixes multiple session, permissions, and UI issues. It also changes inline images to render by default on supported terminals and includes several data/output correctness fixes.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now lets users control the default model and MCP server, and includes updates that make diagnostics easier to resolve. The release also improves chat navigation and account controls.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management is now in public preview. The integration connects centralized governance with runtime enforcement for MCP servers and tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Agentic CLI customizations now in the usage metrics API
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s usage metrics API now includes agentic CLI activity for skills, custom agents, MCP servers, slash commands, and plugins. This extends existing CLI report coverage with additional customization metrics.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Microsoft previewed PostgreSQL skills and an MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The plugin is intended to make supported AI coding assistants context-aware for PostgreSQL and able to provide guidance and perform actions on a connected database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: How Uno Platform uses .NET, MCP, and AI to build high quality apps
item.description:
Uno Platform built two MCP servers in C# to let AI agents use real documentation as context and interact with a running cross-platform .NET app. The post describes how .NET, MCP, and AI are combined to support app development and validation.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app Customize tab is generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s new Customize tab in the Copilot app is now generally available. It is meant to connect Copilot with a team’s existing tools, knowledge, and workflows, including MCP.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise managed settings. Administrators can centrally control plugin governance, MCP server access, OpenTelemetry, and permission modes across the enterprise.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: From single call to agents: five new Claude capabilities now available in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now supports five new Claude capabilities on Azure-hosted models: structured outputs, web search, web fetch, MCP connector, and tool search. The update positions a model endpoint for agent-style workflows rather than single-call usage.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog
